item.title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.

item.tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

answer_sheet.Face and retouching: Keep my facial proportions, expression, apparent age and natural skin texture. No face reshaping or beauty filter.

must_haves: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make your headshot. Magic Hour turned the request down because your account doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created and no credits were spent.

This was the cheapest option on the free plan (the flux-2-klein editor at 640px, about 5 credits for one image). The dedicated headshot tool costs 50 credits, so it would be refused too.

Here's the edit I sent, which I can run again once you have credits:
- **Kept as is:** your face, age, expression, curly hair and natural skin texture, with no smoothing or retouching.
- **Lighting:** soft, even studio light.
- **Outfit:** a dark navy blazer over a plain top instead of the grey sweater.
- **Background:** a plain, softly blurred grey studio backdrop instead of the park.
- **Format:** square, head and shoulders, no text.

To go ahead, add credits by buying a credit pack or upgrading in your Magic Hour account, then tell me. If you'd like a different outfit or background colour (say a white shirt or a light backdrop), let me know now and I'll change it first.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Turn this photo into a professional headshot of the same woman. Keep her face exactly as it is: identical facial features, face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, expression, age and curly dark hair. Do not make her look younger. Keep her natural skin texture, pores and small marks visible; no skin smoothing, no retouching, no beautifying. Change only: replace the grey knit sweater with a tailored dark navy blazer over a simple plain top; replace the park background with a plain, softly blurred neutral grey studio backdrop; use soft, even, flattering studio lighting with a gentle key light and soft fill. Same framing, head and shoulders, looking at the camera, photorealistic. No text.

timeline.text:

The edit route gives me more control over the result, and plan_request has to come before any create or edit call, so I'll make that call first.

I'm setting the parameters for the call now: the subject is the woman in the photo, the edit is tidying the lighting, outfit and background into a professional headshot, and the keep constraints are her recognizable face, age and skin texture. The attachment is square, so I'm checking whether to keep a 1:1 aspect, and there's no text to include.
